Every cost line came in the round's second packet, about 0.09 s after the first reply, and where that step happens (our side or the server's) is open: it decides which of the two the server counts. From the cost line, 21 of the 52 cost lines in this log are within +-0.15 s of their printed value; from the first reply, 50 of 52. An input about our seat, not a refit (plan, Holdout). tools/test_kb_rules.py re-counts it
